responsibility: Declares the C-SKY ISA feature vocabulary and the composite feature macros used by the backend to describe architectural capability sets. It lists individual feature bits for base revisions, divide, DSP, Java, FCR, and FPv2/FPv3 subsets, then defines higher-level macro combinations such as CK803/CK810 and FPU package groupings, so option handling and machine-description predicates can test stable feature names rather than duplicating raw bit lists.
same_name_distinction: This is the declarative source of the C-SKY ISA feature list and composite feature sets: it enumerates feature names via CSKY_ISA(...) and, when CSKY_ISA_MACRO is enabled, defines grouped macros such as CK803/CK810 and FPv2/FPv3 bundles. Unlike csky_isa.h it is not the owning enum/header wrapper itself, but the reused definition file that is included to generate those typed interfaces and macro combinations.
